title: Local finite-free shortening of a pseudo-coherent bounded flat model
statement: Let U⊆T be open in a scheme [def-pc-scheme], t∈U and d≥0. Let C,Q be complexes of O_U-modules [def-pc-derived-category], with C supported in [0,d] and termwise flat over U, Q supported in degrees ≤d and termwise finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module], and e:Q→C a quasi-isomorphism. There is an open t∈V⊆U and a complex P of O_V-modules supported in [0,d] and termwise finite free. For every scheme map g:T′→V and q≥0, H^q(g^*P) is isomorphic to H^q((T′→V→U)^*C). No proper morphism or higher direct image occurs in this assertion.

proof.text: Apply the structural construction theorem to obtain V, P and the induced quasi-isomorphism eP.
Apply the pullback homology comparison theorem to eP for every g and q.

lean.statement: theorem exists_local_finiteFree_shortening {T : Scheme.{u}} (U : T.Opens) (C Q : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ) (hCge : C.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hCle : C.IsStrictlyLE d) (hCflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 U.toScheme)) (hQle : Q.IsStrictlyLE d) (hQfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (Q.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) (e : Q ⟶ C) (he : QuasiIso e) (t : T) (ht : t ∈ U) : ∃ (V : T.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (P : CochainComplex V.toScheme.Modules ℤ), t ∈ V ∧ P.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE d ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) ∧ ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ V.toScheme) (q : ℕ), Nonempty ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P).homology q ≅ (((Modules.pullback (g ≫ T.homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology q)
